content.comment_body: Hello. I am using a new [product_name] [article_no] base module together with a [article_no] expansion module. Inputs and outputs work properly on the base module, and inputs function on the expansion module, but the outputs from the expansion are not working as expected. When I check the display, outputs Q5 to Q8 appear active, and the code also shows them as on, but there is no signal at the physical output terminals. If anyone has advice regarding this issue, I would appreciate it.

Have you supplied operating voltage to the expansion module? Is the LED indicator on the expansion lit? If so, what color is it? Also, have you correctly inserted the contact slide into the base module?

analysis.insight_summary: A user reported that outputs on the expansion module of their [product_name] setup are not producing a physical signal, despite appearing active in both the software and module display. This highlights a possible gap between status indicators and actual hardware output, raising questions about feedback mechanisms and troubleshooting processes for module setup.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects reliable physical output from the expansion module, as well as accurate feedback so that software and display status correspond with actual hardware operation.
